subject: downloadButton Forbidden on Shiny Server Pro

messages.author: f1a78b77bed56547
messages.subject: downloadButton Forbidden on Shiny Server Pro
parts:
Hi,

My Shiny app has a downloadButton() in the ui.R and a corresponding downloadHandler() in server.R. I tested it running local in Windows 7 viewing with Chrome, and it works fine. But when I upload the app to our Shiny Server Pro, it doesn't work. When I click on the download Button, it opens a new tab in Chrome with page title of "Forbidden", and just says "Forbidden" in large bold font on the new tab page.

Help!!

Jonathan

I just found the issue. My variable name ‘.save_file’ starts with a dot (‘.’) because I didn’t want it to get returned by reactiveValuesToList(). When I remove the ‘.’ It works fine.

Please someone mark as complete. Thanks. 

Jonathan
